title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
title_zh: Interactive Video Generation with Speculative Sampling

paragraphs.en: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training. Project page: https://yubo-shankui.github.io/speculative_sampling .
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频生成通常依赖小型双向片段来降低响应延迟。 然而，我们的初步实验表明，更大的片段能够提升视频质量并更有效地利用 GPU 并行性，从而在采样时间仅适度增加的情况下，允许对更多潜在变量进行采样。 基于这些观察结果，我们提出了“推测采样”策略，该策略将大型双向窗口的建模能力与小型窗口的低延迟交互特性相结合。 它通过添加噪声潜在变量作为填充来扩展建模窗口，并将生成的预测结果缓存起来，以便在条件不变时重复使用。 预测结果以增量方式提供，而未确定的未来部分仍然可以被替换。 我们的延迟分析表明，这种方法消除了片段边界所导致的等待时间下限，使优化重点从减少片段大小转向加快每个片段的采样速度。 因此，双向窗口的大小成为同时优化视觉质量和采样时间的决策变量，而非低延迟交互的必要约束。 这为在交互式流媒体系统中部署大型双向模型提供了可能，而无需复杂的流媒体后训练流程。 项目页面：https://yubo-shankui.github.io/speculative_sampling .

paragraphs.en: Interactive video generation requires newly arriving conditions to influence ongoing playback promptly. A viewer may change a camera command or action instruction at any time, while existing video continues to play. Generation throughput alone does not capture this requirement: a fast model can still leave the viewer waiting for a generation or playback boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频生成需要新传入的条件能够即时影响正在进行的播放。 观众可以随时更改摄像头指令或操作指示，而现有视频仍会继续播放。 仅凭生成吞吐量无法体现这一需求：即使模型运行速度快，也可能让观众在生成或播放的边界处等待。

paragraphs.en: A natural route is fine-grained autoregressive generation. Advances in rollout training and few-step distillation have made this route increasingly practical ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Smaller generation chunks provide more frequent opportunities to incorporate new conditions, enabling fine-grained interaction, but may limit joint temporal modeling and parallel efficiency. This raises our central question: must low-latency interaction come at the cost of a smaller bidirectional modeling window?

It expands the modeling window with padding latents and caches their predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged, while allowing the predicted future to be revised when new conditions arrive (Figure 1 ).

paragraphs.en: We first formulate a serving model that separates condition arrivals, generation, output commitment, and playback. Generation is the computation needed for deliverable video output; for the latent diffusion models studied here, it includes DiT sampling and required VAE decoding. The model distinguishes generation time from phase-dependent random-arrival waiting imposed by scheduling and playback boundaries, and identifies replaceable outputs. When new output can enter playback only at chunk boundaries, the chunk duration imposes a waiting floor even if generation is fast.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先构建一个服务模型，该模型将条件到达、生成、输出承诺和播放分离开来。 生成是指为交付视频输出所需的计算；对于本文研究的潜在扩散模型，它包括 DiT 采样和所需的 VAE 解码。 该模型区分了生成时间与调度及播放边界所导致的与阶段相关的随机到达等待时间，并识别出可替换的输出。 当新输出只能在分块边界进入播放时，即使生成过程很快，分块时长也会造成最低限度的等待时间。

paragraphs.en: We next examine chunk size K K , the number of latent frames jointly sampled in one DiT sampling call. Changing K K affects joint temporal modeling and parallel efficiency, as well as the time needed to generate each chunk. Our chunk-size ablation shows higher aggregate video quality for larger-chunk configurations than their frame-wise counterparts in the evaluated settings (Section 4 ). Larger chunks also better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Together with the system model, this motivates retaining the benefits of joint generation while reducing the waiting imposed by coarse output commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们研究分块大小 K K，即在一次 DiT 采样调用中联合采样的潜在帧数量。 改变 K K 会影响联合时间建模和并行效率，以及生成每个分块所需的时间。 我们的分块大小消融实验表明，在评估设置（第 4 节）中，较大分块的配置比逐帧配置具有更高的综合视频质量。 较大的分块也能更好地利用 GPU 并行性，使得只需适度增加采样时间即可采样出更多潜在变量。 结合系统模型来看，这有助于在保持联合生成优势的同时，减少因粗略输出承诺所带来的等待时间。

paragraphs.en: Guided by the system model and chunk-size ablation, we develop our method to combine large-chunk joint generation with fine-grained delivery. We expand the bidirectional modeling window by appending noise latents as padding. Rather than discarding the resulting predictions, we cache them for reuse when the condition remains unchanged, while keeping the uncommitted future replaceable. We formulate the controller as a two-state finite-state machine that coordinates joint generation and incremental consumption of cached predictions, while playback continues independently. This decouples DiT sampling calls from individual deliveries: completed predictions are reused between condition updates, avoiding repeated sampling merely to support finer-grained delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 在系统模型和分块尺寸消融分析的指导下，我们开发了一种方法，将大块联合生成与精细粒度交付相结合。 我们通过添加噪声潜在变量作为填充，扩展了双向建模窗口。 我们不会丢弃由此产生的预测结果，而是将其缓存以便在条件保持不变时重复使用，同时确保未提交的未来内容仍可替换。 我们将控制器设计为一种双状态有限状态机，用于协调联合生成与缓存预测的增量消耗，而播放过程则独立进行。 这种设计将 DiT 采样调用与单次交付解耦：在条件更新之间，已完成的预测结果会被重复使用，从而避免仅为了支持更精细的粒度交付而进行重复采样。

paragraphs.en: The resulting design points to an alternative route to interactive video generation: shrinking chunks need not be a prerequisite for low interaction latency. Instead, the optimization focus can shift to accelerating high-quality joint generation. DiT sampling acceleration and parallel acceleration can support this route. We further demonstrate this route by serving a large bidirectional model in a low-latency interactive streaming system without Self-Forcing-style post-training.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video generation exploits temporal structure by predicting new content conditioned on the past ( Yan et al., 2021 ) . This provides a natural interface for extending videos, including segment-wise continuation under changing prompts ( Villegas et al., 2022 ) . Bringing sequential prediction to diffusion models ( Chen et al., 2024 ) leaves two practical challenges: the cost of repeated sampling and errors accumulated through generated history. Recent progress therefore targets efficient few-step causal generation ( Yin et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) and training aligned with self-generated, long-horizon rollouts ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Related rolling and bidirectional-window approaches retain joint temporal processing during sequential output ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Kodaira et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Rui et al., 2026 ) . NFD additionally describes speculative multi-frame sampling on a frame-causal backbone to improve throughput, but retains a causal mask within the enlarged window and therefore does not exploit bidirectional modeling across it ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . Related control mechanisms include reuse or replanning of fully denoised futures with ground-truth observation feedback ( Lillemark et al., 2026 ) and management of generation–playback lead ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . Our method studies a complementary interface: retaining temporally bidirectional joint generation within each chunk while committing outputs at a finer granularity under newly arriving conditions.

paragraphs.en: Acceleration targets several components of generation cost. Few-step distillation ( Yin et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) and adversarial post-training ( Lin et al., 2025 ) reduce DiT sampling steps. Pyramid Flow performs much of its DiT sampling below full spatial resolution and compresses history through a temporal pyramid ( Jin et al., 2024 ) ; FramePack reduces the historical-context token budget ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . FasterCache and TeaCache reuse intermediate computations across diffusion steps ( Lv et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , whereas Sliding Tile Attention and Sparse VideoGen reduce attention work through local or spatial–temporal sparsity ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Xi et al., 2025 ) . USP addresses distributed attention through sequence parallelism ( Fang and Zhao, 2024 ) . These methods have distinct training and inference requirements. Our perspective shifts the emphasis from shrinking generation chunks to accelerating their generation. By decoupling generation from output commitment, our method highlights per-chunk generation time, rather than chunk size alone, as a key determinant of interaction latency. This places greater importance on accelerating joint generation instead of requiring increasingly fine-grained autoregressive models.

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional teacher models often define the quality target for causal streaming students, yet their full-sequence generation interfaces are not designed for interactive serving. Directly converting the same backbone to causal generation can also introduce a quality gap without careful adaptation ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . This motivates a further extrapolation of chunk size: can a large-chunk bidirectional model itself serve an interactive video stream? We preserve bidirectional joint sampling within each call and adapt its conditioning and output interfaces, allowing successive calls to continue from retained video while outputs are committed incrementally.
paragraphs.zh: 双向教师模型通常定义因果流式学生的质量目标，但其全序列生成接口并未为交互式服务而设计。 若未经仔细适配，直接将相同的骨干网络转换为因果生成模式也可能导致质量差异（Yin 等，2024）。 这促使我们进一步推测分块尺寸的可能性：一个使用大分块的双向模型本身能否支持交互式视频流？ 我们在每次调用中保留双向联合采样机制，并适配其条件输入与输出接口，使得后续调用能够基于保留的视频内容继续执行，同时逐步提交输出结果。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional video generators commonly provide native image- or video-conditioned continuation interfaces, allowing successive jointly sampled chunks to be connected without modifying within-chunk attention. A practical complication arises with temporally compressive 3D VAEs: the continuation interface often expects a temporally uncompressed first-frame latent, whereas an interior cached frame belongs to a temporally compressed latent group. We therefore decode the retained boundary to pixels and re-encode its final frame through the VAE’s first-frame path before the next DiT sampling call. This produces the latent format expected by the pretrained continuation interface. Alternatively, the bidirectional model can be fine-tuned to accept compressed latent continuation directly.
paragraphs.zh: 双向视频生成器通常提供原生的图像或视频条件续接接口，使得连续联合采样的片段能够连接起来，而无需修改片段内部的注意力机制。 在时间压缩的三维 VAE 中会出现一个实际难题：续接接口通常需要时间上未压缩的首帧潜在表示，而中间缓存的帧则属于时间上已压缩的潜在组。 因此，我们将保留的边界解码为像素，并通过 VAE 的首帧路径重新编码其最后一帧，然后再进行下一次 DiT 采样调用。 这样就能生成预训练续接接口所期望的潜在格式。 另一种方法是，可以对双向模型进行微调，使其直接接受压缩后的潜在续接表示。

paragraphs.en: The main limitations are twofold. First, our method benefits from predictions only when they are reused before a new condition invalidates them; frequent or continuous updates can therefore discard much of each sampled chunk and waste substantial DiT computation. Second, with bidirectional within-chunk attention, the retained KV may encode information from a subsequently discarded suffix, so deleting its KV entries may not fully remove its influence on a regenerated continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 主要局限性有两个方面。 首先，我们的方法只有在预测结果在被新条件使其失效之前被重复使用时才能从中受益；因此，频繁或持续的更新可能会丢弃每个采样片段的大部分内容，并浪费大量的 DiT 计算资源。 其次，由于片段内双向注意力机制的存在，保留的 KV 可能编码了后续被丢弃的后缀中的信息，因此删除其 KV 条目可能无法完全消除其对再生续写部分的影响。

paragraphs.en: We have formulated interactive video generation as a joint problem of prediction and output commitment. Our method preserves multi-latent joint generation, reuses completed predictions under unchanged conditions, and replans only the future that can still be replaced while maintaining a feasible playback prefix. This shifts part of the design effort from shrinking the generation unit toward accelerating joint generation, managing revocable predictions, and scheduling timely delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将交互式视频生成定义为一个联合问题，涉及预测与输出承诺。 我们的方法保留了多潜在变量的联合生成机制，在条件不变时重复使用已完成的预测，并且仅对仍可能被替换的未来部分进行重新规划，同时保持可行的播放前缀。 这将部分设计工作从缩小生成单元转向加速联合生成、管理可撤销的预测以及安排及时交付。

paragraphs.en: Generation is the computation needed to produce deliverable video; its general definition does not require a VAE. For the latent diffusion models considered here, C C includes conditioning preparation, DiT sampling, and required VAE decoding on the critical path to the first output group, not necessarily the entire chunk. Overlapping stages are not simply added. R R may include scheduling, resource, and conditioning-input readiness waits; Q Q may include transport and buffering as well as playback alignment. User-end-to-end latency additionally includes processing before t arrival t_{\mathrm{arrival}} . Semantic response, when the condition’s effect is visibly recognizable, is a separate measure. The relation T = K ​ r / f T=Kr/f assumes a uniform latent-to-frame mapping; models with nonuniform mappings or overlap trimming use their actual output frame counts. The temporal frame rate f f is not computational throughput in generated frames per wall-clock second.
paragraphs.zh: 生成是指为产出可用视频所需的计算过程；其通用定义并不要求使用 VAE。 对于本文所考虑的潜在扩散模型，C C 包括条件准备、DiT 采样以及对关键路径上首个输出组（而非整个数据块）所需的 VAE 解码。 重叠阶段并非简单相加。 R R 可能包括调度、资源以及条件输入就绪的等待时间；Q Q 可能包括传输、缓冲以及播放对齐操作。 用户端到端的延迟还包括在 t arrival t_{\mathrm{arrival}} 之前进行的处理。 当条件的效果清晰可见时，语义响应是一个独立的衡量指标。 关系式 T = K ​ r / f T=Kr/f 假设了均匀的潜在到帧的映射；具有非均匀映射或重叠裁剪的模型则使用其实际的输出帧数。 时间帧率 f f 并非指每实际秒生成的帧数这一计算吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: Each event log should include a run identifier, event identifier, condition version, condition-ready time, prefix-ready time, generation start, KV-ready time, DiT sampling completion, VAE decoding completion, first deliverable output time, target switch boundary, actual display time, and final outcome. paragraphs.en: For a generator with history-conditioned DiT sampling, the adapter exposes the selected prefix’s inference state at the correct positions. Direct suffix entries are invalidated while the retained KV is reused. This preserves the original inference representations; it does not reconstruct them from clean latents. An implementation that instead builds KV by clean prefill of each retained latent is a different cache policy. An LTX proposal-reuse implementation may instead use incremental clean prefill; that should be identified separately from direct retained-KV reuse. Neither policy can erase old-future information already present in fixed prefix latent values. Separating the additional effect of KV reuse requires a matched controlled ablation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于具有历史条件 DiT 采样的生成器，适配器会在正确的位置暴露所选前缀的推理状态。 直接的后缀条目会被失效，而保留的 KV 则会被重复使用。 这保留了原始的推理表示；它并非从干净的潜在变量中重新构建这些表示。 另一种实现方式是通过对每个保留的潜在变量进行干净的预填充来构建 KV，这是一种不同的缓存策略。 LTX 提案重用实现可能改用增量式干净预填充；这种实现应与直接重复使用保留的 KV 区分开来。 这两种策略都无法消除已存在于固定前缀潜在值中的旧有未来信息。 要分离 KV 重复使用的额外影响，需要进行匹配的受控消融分析。

paragraphs.en: The bidirectional image-conditioned path retrieves the full-resolution RGB frame immediately preceding the selected branch from the retained timeline, then submits it through the checkpoint’s native image conditioning interface with the latest available prompt. The H3 image-conditioned path can implement this operation without a new temporal causal mask or wrapper-specific training. This path conditions on the boundary image rather than full-prefix KV or equivalent long-range context.
paragraphs.zh: 双向图像条件路径从保留的时间线中检索出所选分支之前一帧的全分辨率 RGB 图像，然后通过检查点的原生图像条件接口，结合最新可用的提示词将其提交。 H3 图像条件路径无需新的时间因果掩码或包装器特定的训练即可实现此操作。 该路径以边界图像为条件，而非完整前缀 KV 或等效的长范围上下文。

paragraphs.en: The H3 experimental latent-input path replaces image encoding with a normalized clean video latent while retaining condition packing and condition-noise handling. This differs from copying the latent into the target noise tensor, and its conditioning distribution differs from that of a single encoded image. A separate multi-frame path supplies a phase-aligned group of retained latents as keyframe conditions and removes the corresponding output overlap. These variants change context, eligible boundaries, and preparation costs, and are reported separately from the boundary-image adapter.

paragraphs.en: A native clip may include a regenerated anchor or context span. The output adapter omits that span and maps only the remaining pixels to the new playback interval. It retains source indices for subsequent anchors, and never selects history from a discarded or trimmed-away prediction. This mapping can have nonuniform latent-to-frame spans and fewer playable groups than sampled latents; the controller uses their actual deadlines.
paragraphs.zh: 原始剪辑可能包含一个再生锚点或上下文片段。 输出适配器会省略该片段，并将仅将剩余的像素映射到新的播放区间。 它会保留后续锚点的源索引，并且绝不会从被丢弃或裁剪掉的预测中选取历史数据。 这种映射可能具有非均匀的潜在变量到帧的跨度，并且可播放组的数量少于采样的潜在变量；控制器会使用它们的实际截止时间。

paragraphs.en: Streaming VAE decoding can publish finalized groups before the entire clip has finished decoding, while DiT sampling remains joint over the chunk. This does not imply that a prefix of bidirectional DiT sampling is available early. VAE overlap and any state dependent on a replaced suffix must be handled before pixels are committed; the adapter may instead decode the full clip and deliver its completed frames incrementally. Group-ready and job-finish events remain separate in both cases. History encoding, cache construction, VAE decoding, and mandatory overlap work are included in the corresponding timing and cost measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 流式 VAE 解码可以在整个片段解码完成之前发布最终确定的组块，而 DiT 采样则在整个分块上保持联合处理。 这并不意味着双向 DiT 采样的前缀部分可以提前可用。 在像素被最终确定之前，必须处理 VAE 的重叠部分以及任何依赖于被替换后缀的状态；替代方案是，适配器可以先解码整个片段，然后逐步输出其完成的帧。 在这两种情况下，组块就绪事件和任务完成事件仍然是独立的。 历史编码、缓存构建、VAE 解码以及必要的重叠处理工作都包含在相应的时序和成本测量中。

paragraphs.en: Accelerating joint DiT sampling is one route to retaining large chunks, but the serving objective is to reduce generation time C C to the first deliverable output group. A natural next step is to co-design DiT sampling and VAE decoding as a single generation pipeline rather than optimize their isolated runtimes. This includes when completed latent groups are handed to the VAE decoder, how decoding is scheduled against playback deadlines, and how compute and memory are allocated between stages.
paragraphs.zh: 加速联合 DiT 采样是保留大块内容的一种方法，但服务的目标是将生成时间 C C 缩短到首个可交付输出组。 一个自然的下一步是将 DiT 采样和 VAE 解码共同设计为单一生成流程，而不是分别优化它们的独立运行时间。 这包括在完成的潜在组被传递给 VAE 解码器时的处理方式、解码如何根据播放截止日期进行调度，以及计算资源和内存如何在各阶段之间分配。

paragraphs.en: Overlap schedules must respect the data dependencies of temporally bidirectional DiT sampling and VAE decoding. Candidate schedules should measure time to the first deliverable group, later-group deadlines, total GPU cost, and playback stalls. Parallel acceleration should be evaluated within the complete pipeline and resource budget.
paragraphs.zh: 重叠的调度必须尊重时间双向 DiT 采样和 VAE 解码的数据依赖关系。 候选调度应衡量首个交付组所需的时间、后续组的截止日期、总 GPU 成本以及播放卡顿情况。 并行加速应在完整的管道和资源预算范围内进行评估。
